subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these 14 upstream action revisions be accepted as one privileged batch after exact-head validation, or should the credential-bearing action families be split for separate approval?
rationale: The diff is mechanically consistent, but code executed with repository secrets and publishing or scanning permissions requires an explicit trust decision that CI alone cannot make.

options.title: Audit and approve the batch
options.body: Review the upstream revisions for Codex, token issuance, Docker publishing, and CodeQL, then merge only after the refreshed exact head passes its affected workflows.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and security-scanning pins so each trust boundary can be reviewed and validated independently.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Leave the PR open until Dependabot can refresh it and the currently incomplete or failing exact-head checks have a stable explanation.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the batch
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions for Codex, token issuance, Docker publishing, and CodeQL, then merge only after the refreshed exact head passes its affected workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans both Codex-agent workflow hardening and release-workflow action modernization.
